page.layout: One scan: a colour calibration target (QPcard 201 with a grey scale ruler and colour patches, and QPcard 101 v2 with white and grey patches) on a grey card. Below it a paper label. No printed text block.
page.notes: No book page is printed on this scan. It shows a colour calibration target: a QPcard 201 with 30 colour and grey patches and a numbered scale (10 to 130), and a QPcard 101 v2 with white and dark grey patches. The label "SUB Göttingen / GDZ | 2009" is a digitiser's label, so it is left out. The target has no printed words to transcribe.
